basis: The chart is titled 'Public Service Feedback Share by Category'. The printed percentage labels provide the explicit values for feedback share: Service Quality (41%), Service Cost (46%), Service Design (51%), Support Access (42%), Service Delivery (36%), and Other (10%). The vertical axis is labeled 'Value' and its scale (0-65) does not align with the percentage labels (e.g., Service Quality is at ~60 on the axis but labeled 41%), indicating the axis position is not the intended encoding for the share. The highest printed share is 51%, which corresponds to the 'Service Design' category. The task requires routing the highest-share category to the priority follow-up workflow.
option_label: Route Service Design to public feedback priority follow-up
